sentences.text: 1 CLAIM PETITION BY GRANTING THE RELIEF AS PRAYED FAR BY THE APPELLANT.
THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR ADMISSION THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:

JUDGMENT Not being satisfied with quantum of compensation granted by the Tribunal, appellant, who is the petitioner has come up with this appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act' for short).
2.
For the sake of convenience, the parties are referred to by their rank before the Tribunal.
3. It is the case of the petitioner that on 13.07.2018 at about 9:10 p.m., she was proceeding on the left side of the road near S.S.Reddy hospital, Raichur.

At that time, respondent No.1 being the rider of motorcycle bearing Reg.No.KA-36-EK-5397 (hereinafter referred to as 'offending vehicle' for short) came in a rash or negligent manner and dashed against the petitioner.

She sustained grievous injuries and took treatment at Shivam Research Centre Hospital, Raichur, RIMS Raichur,
Government Hospital, Ballari and also NIMHANS Bengaluru and spent more than Rs.5,00,000/-.
Despite prolonged treatment, she is not completely cured.
It has affected her earning capacity and resulting in loss of income.
As owner and insurer, respondents are liable to pay the compensation jointly and severally liable to pay compensation.

4. Respondents appeared and filed their separate written statement disputing the age, occupation and nature of injuries sustained by the petitioner and that it has resulted in disability affecting her income.
The compensation claimed is highly exorbitant and fanciful and without any basis.
5. Based on the pleadings, the Tribunal framed necessary issues.

6. Petitioner examined herself as PW.1 and got marked Exs.P1 to 10.
7.
On behalf of respondent, Ex.R1 is marked.
8. Vide the impugned judgment and award, Tribunal has granted compensation in a sum of Rs.2,72,000/- with interest at 8% p.a. and directed respondent No.2 to pay the same.

9. In this appeal, the petitioner is seeking enhancement contending that looking to the nature of injuries sustained and period of treatment, the compensation granted is on the lower side and it requires enhancement.

sentences.text:
Based on the complaint filed in respect of the accident after conducting detailed investigation,
the jurisdictional police have filed charge-sheet against respondent No.1.
The same is established the fact that the accident occurred due to rash or negligent driving by the respondent No.1 and in the said accident, petitioner sustained injuries.

11. Though petitioner has claimed that due to injuries she has suffered permanent partial disability affecting her ability to lead a normal life and thereby her earning capacity, she has not examined the doctor who treated her.
There is also no document to prove that petitioner has suffered any disability whether partial or otherwise.

Having regard to the nature of injuries suffered, period of treatment, the Tribunal has rightly granted compensation in a sum of Rs.40,000/- under the head pain and suffering, Rs.20,000/- under the head food, nourishment and conveyance, Rs.15,000/-
under the head attendant charges, Rs.40,000/- under the head loss of amenities.
They require no interference.

12. Taking notional income of the petitioner at Rs.7,000/- per month for a period of three months,
the Tribunal has granted compensation in a sum of Rs.21,000/- towards compensation during laid up period.
Since the accident is of the year 2018, the notional income ought to have been taken at Rs.11,750/-.

In the facts and circumstances, the compensation under the head laid up period is enhanced by Rs.10,000/-i.e. petitioner is entitled compensation in a sum of Rs.31,000/- as against Rs.21,000/- granted by the Tribunal.

13. Thus, in all petitioner is entitled for additional compensation in a sum of Rs.10,000/- and accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER
(i) The Appeal is allowed in part.
(ii) The appellant is entitled for compensation in a sum of Rs.2,82,000/- as against Rs.2,72,000/- granted by the Tribunal with interest at 6% p.a. on the enhanced compensation.

(iii) Respondent No.2/Insurance company shall deposit the compensation amount within a period of six weeks from the date of this order together with interest (minus compensation amount already paid/deposited) on the enhanced compensation.
(iv) Send a copy of this order to the Tribunal.
